experiment.name: gate1paper-cifar100-paper_composition
experiment.status: The paper's SSL estimator implemented literally: supplement Eq. (6)-(10) and section Eq. (25). Truncated symmetric inverse roots at relative cutoff tau=1e-3, shared per level; composition is the PLAIN ordered product (truncated whitening is idempotent, so no Gram inverse is inserted); every trace score uses those same shared coordinates; no EMA; no stopped-gradient endpoint; gradients propagate through the Gram transforms; an empty retained set flags the batch and takes no update. Differs from the bigcal V7 arm in all of those respects, which is the point: V7 used ridge whitening, which the supplement explicitly calls a different operator estimate. CIFAR-100 replication: only dataset, root and the calibration budget differ from the CIFAR-10 arm.

objective_note: additive variants take their maximizing per-edge sign inside the module; alpha/beta here only affect product_endpoint
